features.name: Foundation
features.description: Create the TanStack Start and Cloudflare deployment foundation with D1, Drizzle, and repeatable local verification.
doneCriteria: Lint, type-check, and tests have runnable commands

features.name: Trip domain and revisions
features.description: Persist trips, itinerary revisions, draft/confirmed states, and safe discard behavior.
doneCriteria: Confirmed itinerary remains intact during edits
Draft revision can be accepted or discarded

features.name: Conversational trip planning
features.description: Stream a planning conversation that gathers requirements and produces a Zod-validated draft itinerary.
doneCriteria: User can refine a draft through chat

features.name: Trip views and map
features.description: Show draft and confirmed trips, day-by-day itinerary, costs, and mapped travel legs.
doneCriteria: Trips list separates draft and confirmed

features.name: Preference memory and guidance
features.description: Use user-approved explicit preferences in planning and attach sourced cultural/legal guides to destinations.
doneCriteria: Guidance displays source and update date
